description: EIA-860 Generator Data Cases, published by Texas A&M University, organizes US EIA-860 generator information into power-flow case structures, with cases for 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2024. Coverage: The source covers US generators of at least 1 MW; available case vintages are 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2024. Utilities, plants, units and states are mapped into power-flow structures. The linked provider page supplies documentation and the access route; no resource files were downloaded. The licence is Not stated on the reviewed page. Price and access terms require confirmation unless explicitly stated above. Limitations: These are derived generator cases, not proof that a complete observed transmission network or every EIA field is included. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: Catalogue records for comparison are data-tamu-electric-grid-test-cases. Compatibility with these records has not been assumed.
